description: The ready WakeHuBERT 'hey potato' model at its own calibrated default threshold (0.15).
notes: models.json at 2ac92d3b: featurizer wakehubert-int8. Threshold, smoothing and debounce come from the model's own metadata. Training data per models.json: synthetic only: an edge-tts voice grid, voice-converted copies of edge-tts clips, OmniVoice clips, each checked against a speech recogniser transcript, with eight held-out edge-tts test voices excluded; LibriSpeech train-clean-100 (CC BY 4.0) mixed in as background babble; negatives from wakeforge datasets/train.csv and the even half of an AudioSet noise sample.
